title: The Yes and the Amen: Final Cosmic Scaffolding Revealed as Calling and Hearing
description: The closing teaching first surveys the structural scaffolding of the cosmos — pillars, firmaments, four bearing-angels, twelve and twenty-two angels, three great pillars of strength, the great Omophoros, the Five Sons as food of the man — then turns to ask what the liturgical "Yes" and "Amen" mean, answering that they are nothing other than the Calling and the Hearing, the very principles by which the First Man was raised and by which the Living Soul is now refined wherever she is dispersed in tree and in the fashioning of flesh.
